description_en: A double chair with two opposite-facing woven seats sharing one central tall back frame; the front shows one complete seat, the side reveals the mirrored seat platforms on either side, and the rear shows the second seat with its own arm openings and stretcher. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: A double chair with two opposite-facing woven seats sharing one central tall back frame; the front shows one complete seat, the side reveals the mirrored seat platforms on either side, and the rear shows the second seat with its own arm openings and stretcher. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.. Style Sang trọng: refined precise proportions and minimal plain hardware. Relative size medium within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact REAR ELEVATION: orbit camera 180 degrees from canonical front, level with product center, directly facing its back. Show rear supports, rear surfaces and described rear features. The front-facing features must be hidden on the opposite side. Do not mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions. STRUCTURE CLARIFICATION: This is a double BACK-TO-BACK joined chair unit: exact rear elevation faces the SECOND chair which points 180 degrees opposite to the first. It shows the second chair's seat and plain arms directly in front of the SAME shared woven back frame, while the first chair is hidden behind it. It must look like the opposite-facing matching chair, not the bare back of a single armchair. Exactly TWO opposed chairs in the unit; no third seat, no radial wings, no added mast. Keep front-reference design and materials.
